title: Crochet stitch abbreviations
items: Crochet stitch names show the abbreviation their written pattern uses, such as Single Crochet (sc) and Half Double Crochet (hdc), in each language's own terms

title: Thirty-three new quilt blocks
items: 33 new quilt blocks, bringing the library from 39 to 72
Four more Advanced blocks: Pineapple, Storm at Sea, New York Beauty and Lone Star
New stars, curves, appliqué and picture blocks, among them Rising Star, Card Trick, Spider Web, Orange Peel, Grandmother's Fan, Schoolhouse and Sailboat
Piecing steps list each unit size on its own, so blocks that mix sizes trim every unit correctly

title: Quilts that look like cloth
items: Quilt blocks and layouts drawn as fabric: a fine weave, each piece softly puffed between its seams
Dashed quilting stitches a quarter inch inside each piece, down the sashing and around the border
SVG and PNG downloads in the fabric look or in flat color
Quilt block pictures in the library each take their own colorway

title: Cables, lace, puffs and clusters
items: New knitting stitches: Rope Cable, Horseshoe Cable and Feather and Fan lace
New crochet stitches: Puff Stitch and Cluster Stitch
Charts and written rows for cables, yarn overs, decreases, puffs and clusters, with their abbreviations
Knit stitch pictures redrawn to look like the fabric, each in its own yarn color
Category pages share a picture made of their own patterns
Language links sit in a darker band above the menu

title: Advanced patterns
items: New quilt blocks: Mariner's Compass and Snail's Trail, the first marked Advanced, and Kaleidoscope
New knitting stitch: diamond brocade, the first at Intermediate
New crochet colorwork: eight-point star, houndstooth and argyle
Crochet stitch pictures redrawn to show each stitch's loops and height, each in its own yarn color
Language links with flags, first in the menu bar
Share pictures name the kind of pattern in the page's language, and pattern pages have clearer titles in search results

title: Wider nature pattern sizes
items: Nature patterns now range from 25% to 300% in size, with up to ±90% size variation, for far more mixed motifs in one repeat

title: Weaving drafts
items: New weaving drafter: plain weave, twills, herringbone, point and broken twills, satin, basket, huck, overshot, M's and O's, summer and winter and rosepath, on 4, 8 or 16 shafts
The full draft with threading, tie-up, treadling and drawdown, striped warp and weft, a seamless cloth repeat, 26 traditional drafts and a printable PDF draft
Weaving joins the top menu and the front page

title: Kolam
items: New kolam maker: sikku, pulli and kambi kolam around a square, diamond or hexagonal grid of dots, in a seamless repeat
A sikku is always one closed line; symmetric or seeded random tiles, single or double lines, and SVG, PNG and PDF downloads

title: Turing patterns
items: New Turing pattern maker: spots, mitosis, coral, labyrinth, stripes, worms, holes and bubbles, grown by a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation
Grid, steps, spread direction and edge level, with filled, outline or two-band styles, in a seamless repeat with SVG, PNG and PDF downloads

title: Chinese lattice
items: New Chinese lattice maker: square fret, octagons and squares, hexagons, diagonal, interlocking frames and ice-ray, in thick bars with clean joins
Bar width, cell density, up to three nested frames, a solid frame or open edge, and a seeded ice-ray that still repeats, with SVG, PNG and PDF downloads

title: Kaleidoscopes
items: Added a kaleidoscope maker with two-mirror, square, 60-60-60, 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 mirror systems
The source turns live with a dial, slider or spin button, and links, downloads and PDFs follow the angle on screen

title: Wave patterns
items: New wave pattern maker: sine, cosine, tangent, square, triangle, sawtooth, damped, interference, moiré and Lissajous figures
Lines or filled bands, with phase, drift and an optional second wave, in a seamless repeat with SVG, PNG and PDF downloads

title: Spiral and cone checkerboards
items: Added spiral and cone layouts to the checkerboard maker, for every pattern, with the grid still the default
Round boards download as SVG, PNG and PDF, with a repeat that sets them on a square of their first color

title: Nature patterns
items: Added a nature pattern maker for seamless leaves, flowers, clouds, pebbles, ferns and grass
Added scattered and jittered grid layouts, with density, size, variation, rotation and outline settings

title: Pattern margins
items: On wide screens, the margins either side of each page show a faint repeat of the site's own patterns, truchet arcs on one side and a tessellation on the other

title: Mandala colors by style
items: Each mandala drawing style now opens in its own colors: sapphire for sharp, lavender for smooth, tide for wavy, mid-century for geometric, fern for flowing, terracotta for hand-sketched and neon for pixel art. Classic keeps its colors

title: Italian and Dutch
items: Added Italian and Dutch, including generated instructions and PDFs
Added language links and a color accent for each

title: Mandala styles and more patterns
items: New drawing styles for mandalas: sharp, smooth, wavy, geometric, flowing, hand-sketched and pixel art
New options for truchet tiles, checkerboards, stained glass, tie-dye, tartans and girih

title: Paper puzzles
items: New paper puzzles section in the menu, with sudoku, futoshiki, nonograms, battleships, dots and boxes, ultimate tic-tac-toe and hex, alongside mazes
Each sheet downloads as a PDF for US Letter, A4 or a tablet page, or as SVG or PNG
Dots and boxes up to 200 boxes across, on every poster size from US Letter to 4A0

title: Faster repeat designs
items: Designs now load with cacheable requests, so settings that have been drawn before can come back without being drawn again

title: Hidden message mazes
items: New hidden message shape for mazes: type a message and the only route from the top left to the bottom right spells it out, with a grid sized to fit

title: Maze PDF without the solution
items: The maze tool can now download its printable PDF without the solution page, ready to use as an activity sheet

title: Letter and Legal maze sheets
items: Maze posters can now be made on US Letter and US Legal paper

title: Animated maze solution
items: Choosing a maze's Solution tab now draws the route from start to exit, and a button plays it again

title: Customization analytics
items: Site analytics now count when a design's settings are changed, by tool and setting name, and the privacy pages say so

title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
items: New Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages, linked from the footer of every page

title: Site analytics
items: The site now uses Google Analytics, and the Your data section explains what is collected and how to opt out, and that settings are sent to our server to draw designs

title: Quilts and stitches now run on the API
items: Quilt block, knitting and crochet builders, their PDFs and their pictures are now generated by the API, like every other tool, and those pages now share with a picture of their own pattern

title: Better link previews
items: Every generator page now shares with a picture of its pattern, and every page has its own title, description and link details for social sites and messaging apps

title: More patterns in five tools
items: Added new options so every library entry shows six: double arc and woven Truchet tiles, Orchard and Tide pool plaids, honeycomb and pinwheel stained glass, 16-fold stars, and sunburst, chevron and double spiral tie-dye

title: Game of Life patterns
items: Added Game of Life patterns as printable repeating designs, with phase strips and the rule explained on any cell

title: Preview images
items: Pattern pages can now include a preview image in their HTML, for search engines and share cards

title: More checkerboards and mazes
items: Added honeycomb and triangle checkerboards, with true hexagons and triangles in the board, repeat tile and PDF
Added triangle and diamond mazes, with every algorithm, the poster PDF and PNG

title: Checkerboard maker
items: Added a checkerboard maker with your own rows, columns, box ratios and colors

title: Blog images
items: Added a featured image for each post on the blog page

title: Crochet colorwork squares
items: Added crochet colorwork at /crochet/colorwork/: tapestry charts, corner-to-corner graphs and granny squares, each written out as a complete multi-color square with a printable PDF

title: Knit colorwork patterns
items: Added knit colorwork: thirteen original stranded, mosaic and intarsia charts, written as complete squares with a float check, yarn per color and a PDF

title: Fractal maker
items: Added a fractal maker, with nine types, SVG and PNG downloads and a printable PDF

title: Poster-size mazes
items: Mazes with your own columns and rows, Master and Extreme levels, poster PDFs and very large PNGs

title: Maze generator
items: Added a maze generator with square, rectangular, circular and hexagonal mazes, five algorithms, a PDF with a separate solution page, and SVG and PNG of the maze and its solution

title: Tie-dye planner
items: Added a tie-dye planner, with a preview, dye map, mixing amounts and a printable PDF

title: Complete cross-stitch and needlepoint projects
items: Split needlepoint into its own maker, with canvas mesh, stitch and yarn choices, and a blocking and finishing margin
Both makers now give materials, stitching order, skein estimates, and framing or pillow steps
Added six complete square designs to each maker, and PDF charts that split over sheets with overlap

title: Complete crochet squares
items: Crochet stitch pages and PDFs now write a complete square: materials, foundation chain, every row with stitch counts, an edging with corners, and finishing
Added 6, 8, 10 and 12 inch square sizes to the crochet builder

title: Complete knitted squares
items: Knitting stitch pages now write a complete square pattern, in 6, 8, 10 or 12 inch sizes, on the page and in the PDF

title: Mandala rings, palettes and pattern pages
items: Ring-by-ring mandala builder with drag and drop and nine new motifs
Palette library by theme and color harmony, with your own palettes saved in the browser
Pages and thumbnails for the main options of eight makers
Front page and library with more patterns of each type, in alphabetical order
Language now changes only one secondary color
Seeds are remembered in your browser instead of in links

title: Truchet tile maker
items: Added a Truchet tile maker, with seamless SVG and PNG repeats and a printable PDF

title: Geometric stars and girih maker
items: Added a geometric stars and girih maker, with true five-tile girih, 4, 6, 8 and 12-fold star patterns, seamless repeats, stencils, wall panels and PDFs

title: Mandala maker
items: Added a mandala maker for geometric radial designs, with colored SVG and PNG, coloring pages and printable PDFs

title: Stained glass pattern maker
items: Added a stained glass pattern maker, with numbered true-size templates, strict cutting rules and a rough glass estimate

title: Celtic knot maker
items: Added a Celtic knot maker, with cut files, tattoo stencils, coloring pages, PNG and printable PDF

title: Sashiko stitch guides
items: Added a sashiko stitch guide maker, with true-size printable guides, gaps at the crossings, and SVG and PNG panels

title: Tessellation maker
items: Added a tessellation maker with all 17 wallpaper groups, seamless repeats, tile layouts and printable PDFs

title: Cross-stitch and needlepoint maker
items: Added a cross-stitch and needlepoint maker, with an editable grid, printable symbol charts, stitch counts, rough thread estimates and finished sizes

title: Tartan and plaid maker
items: Added a tartan and plaid maker, with seamless swatches, weaving guides and yarn estimates

title: Five languages
items: Added Spanish, French, German and Brazilian Portuguese, including generated instructions and PDFs
Added language links on every page
Added a subtle color shift and default palette for each language

title: Pattern library samples
items: Added a sample to every entry in the pattern library, with static examples for the planned tools

title: Blog and changelog
items: Added a blog, with samples that open in the matching tool
Added this changelog

title: Pattern library preview
items: Added a pattern library that lists working tools and planned ones
Fixed the site navigation running off the screen on phones

title: Knitting and crochet
items: Added 9 knitting stitches and 7 crochet stitches
Added starting counts, written rows, charts and yarn estimates based on your size and gauge
Added printable PDF patterns for every stitch

title: More quilt blocks
items: Added 14 blocks, for 36 in total
Added blocks with folded corners, curves and appliqué, cut from PDF templates
Corrected the Anvil block's layout

title: Quilt block builder
items: First release, with 22 traditional quilt blocks
Added cutting lists, yardage, seamless repeats, share links and PDF templates
